title: DC-area forecast: Humid again with storm chances today; hotter early week
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Another warm and humid one, with a mix of sun and clouds. Highs climb into the upper 80s to low 90s, while the humidity pushes feels-like temperatures near 100. Scattered thunderstorms are possible by late afternoon or evening, with a few capable of becoming strong.

What’s next? Muggy and warm weather continues into the start of the workweek. Storm chances decrease after today, with partly to mostly sunny skies Sunday and Monday before higher showers and thunderstorm odds return Tuesday.

Today’s daily digit — 3/10: Feels-like temperatures reaching near 100, plus the chance for a few strong to severe afternoon storms, make today one to enjoy the A/C indoors. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Saturday): Partly sunny skies rule, with highs in the upper 80s to low 90s. Dew points in the low 70s make it feel up to 10 degrees hotter than the actual temperature. It should be mostly dry much of the day, with a chance of a few scattered thunderstorms after about 3 p.m. Storms shouldn’t be too numerous, as a shift in the winds higher in the atmosphere will make it harder for them to organize, but a couple could become strong to severe with potential for damaging wind. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: A few scattered storms remain possible through about sunset. Not much relief from the mugginess, with lows only dropping into the mid- or upper 70s. A quiet, dry night is expected under partly cloudy skies. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Sunday): A bit of relief from the humidity is expected, though it likely won’t change the overall feel much, with dew points still in the upper 60s to near 70. Partly cloudy to mostly sunny skies, with highs again in the upper 80s to low 90s. Heat indexes in the mid-90s or so keep it feeling hot and muggy. Most areas stay dry, though a pop-up afternoon shower or storm is possible, mainly south of DC. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: The heat simmers down a bit after sunset, but the humidity sticks around, keeping the overnight hours feeling warm and sticky. Lows fall into the low to mid-70s under mostly clear skies with a few passing clouds. Confidence: Medium-High

A look ahead

Highs climb into the low to mid-90s Monday and Tuesday. Heat indexes are once again near 100 both days, with sticky dew points still up near 70. Monday should be mostly sunny with an isolated late-day shower or storm possible. Partly sunny Tuesday with a chance of isolated to scattered showers or storms, mainly during the afternoon and evening hours. Confidence: Medium

A weak cold front currently looks to sink into the region Wednesday, bringing a chance for some rain in the morning and isolated afternoon storms. Highs aim for the mid-80s to around 90 under partly to mostly cloudy skies, and it's still fairly humid. Confidence: Medium

Temperatures are still warm Thursday and Friday with highs in the mid- to upper 80s. Humidity could come down (dew points falling to the mid- to upper 60s), if the front heads far enough south. We may still hang on to an isolated shower or storm chance. Confidence: Low-Medium
